sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Unique-values dropdown "Entity info" name-collision split (added in the previous release for two different MusicBrainz areas sharing a display name, e.g. a city and a state both named "New York") was being applied to every entity type instead of just areas — on pages like `work-recordings`, many different recordings sharing one track title exploded the dropdown into one numbered entry per recording instead of staying a single merged entry. Scoped the split to area collisions only.
